headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 40.9/100; Strait of Hormuz is the lead driver, -61% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **40.9/100** (**high**), up 5.0 pts week-over-week. 2 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Strait of Hormuz**, running **15.0/day** vs a normal of **38.8/day** (-61%) — a sustained level shift, not a fresh blip.
**376** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Sunda Strait** is running **37% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$86.99/bbl** (+2.33% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$544.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$2.1M** cost-of-delay ($1.1M–$3.3M).
